description: Enhance LessonCard with 3D tilt effect on hover, animated gradient border, typing animation for code preview, improved staggered card entrance, scale+glow on hover, and animated progress bar for viewed lessons. Must preserve Link navigation, viewed badge, topic chips, and all card metadata display.
steps: 1. In src/components/sections/LessonCard.jsx: Create a custom useTilt hook using useMotionValue and useTransform to calculate rotateX/rotateY based on mouse position relative to card. Apply perspective transform to the card wrapper. Gate behind useReducedMotion check

2. In src/components/sections/LessonCard.css: Add .lesson::before with animated gradient border using @keyframes gradient-rotate that rotates a conic-gradient. Use clip-path or mask to show only border. Add CSS variable --border-opacity that changes on hover

3. In src/components/sections/LessonCard.jsx: Add typing animation to .code-preview using motion.span elements that reveal characters sequentially. Use variants with staggerChildren: 0.02 and custom delay based on card index. Show cursor at end of typing
4. In src/components/sections/LessonCard.css: Add @keyframes glow-pulse for box-shadow animation on hover. Add .lesson:hover with scale transform (1.02) and animated box-shadow using the keyframe
5. In src/components/sections/LessonCard.jsx: Enhance cardVariants with custom delay based on index prop passed from parent. Add viewport margin for earlier trigger

6. In src/components/sections/LessonCard.jsx and LessonCard.css: Add animated progress bar under thumbnail for viewed lessons. Create .progress-bar div with width animated from 0 to 100% when viewed=true. Style with gradient background and height 3px
7. Verify: Run 'npm run build' and confirm no errors. Ensure Link to='/lesson/${lesson.slug}' routing still works.
acceptance_criteria: Cards have subtle 3D tilt effect following mouse position on hover
Cards have animated gradient border that rotates on hover
Code preview text has typing animation when card enters viewport
Cards scale up (1.02x) and have glowing shadow on hover
Card entrance animation is staggered based on position in grid
Viewed lessons show animated progress bar filling to 100%
All interactions (click to navigate, hover states) preserved
npm run build passes with no errors

findings: Implemented all LessonCard animations: 1) 3D tilt effect using useMotionValue/useTransform hooks tracking mouse position with perspective transform, 2) Animated gradient border using conic-gradient with @keyframes rotation on hover, 3) Typing animation for code preview using IntersectionObserver with staggered start based on card index, 4) Scale (1.02x) + glow-pulse keyframe animation on hover, 5) Improved staggered card entrance with index-based delay, 6) Progress bar for viewed lessons with shimmer animation. All animations respect prefers-reduced-motion via useReducedMotion hook. Dark mode support added. Link navigation, viewed badge, topic chips, and all card metadata preserved.
